title: Processes Hardening Follow-up: Runtime Governance, Typed Contracts, and Scenario Resilience
hardRequirements: Processes remain generic and must not become a software-delivery-only engine.
Do not confuse Processes with Workflows. Workflows are executable roles under Agents; Processes own process state, artifacts, transitions, governance, and finalization.
Keep PostgreSQL-only runtime assumptions. Do not reintroduce SQLite runtime or SQLite-specific migrations.
Every subbundle must include failing-first or red-team proof, passing proof, source assertions, anti-stub audit, and changed-file hashes.
Avoid prompt-only fixes. Runtime contracts, policy checks, persistence, and tests are required.
